Specification of State Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
7.7.10 ActionListItem SetNetworkHandle
To support switching of NetworkHandles within
StateMachine States
the
Set-
NetworkHandle ActionListItem
was introduced. To make this work a mapping
SmInteractsWithNmMapping
between
NmNetworkHandle
and
StateManage-
mentNmActionItem
has to be configured.
[SWS_SM_00625] ActionListItem - SetNetworkHandle FullCom
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005, RS_SM_00401
⌈
When a
SetNetworkHandle ActionListItem
with parameter
FullCom
is found
in the
ActionLists
,
StateMachine
shall set the corresponding NetworkHandle to
FullCom
.
⌋
[SWS_SM_00626] ActionListItem - SetNetworkHandle NoCom
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005, RS_SM_00401
⌈
When a
SetNetworkHandle ActionListItem
with parameter
NoCom
is found in
the
ActionLists
,
StateMachine
shall set the corresponding NetworkHandle to
NoCom
.
⌋
